usedFor: Each new WordPress user is registered for a Zoom webinar.

bestTemplate.name: “New User Created” in Wordpress, then “Register Attendee for Webinar” in Zoom
bestTemplate.why: A new sign-up is the one WordPress event here that carries a person worth registering.

watchOut: Triggers like “Post Deleted” and “User Deleted” would also try to register people, so pick “New User Created”.
